role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 育母蜘蛛在蛛网中滑行，培育出一支蜘蛛大军直捣敌人的基地。猎物一旦靠近，她将与自己的孩子一同袭击，释放内心无法满足的狩猎天性，咬得敌人麻痹不动。
hero_summary_en: Gliding along her webs, Broodmother births an army of spiders to lead her team's forces toward the enemy base. As prey wanders near, she joins her children and attacks, slowing foes with incapacitating bites as she indulges her insatiable hunger.

abilities.name: broodmother_insatiable_hunger
abilities.description_zh: 对活物体液的强烈饥渴提高了育母蜘蛛的攻击力，并使她和她的小蜘蛛的攻击附带吸血效果。
abilities.description_en: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.

shard_loc.en: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by %shard_damage_per_tick%%% every %shard_damage_tick_interval%s.
shard_loc.zh: 开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每%shard_damage_tick_interval%秒提升%shard_damage_per_tick%%%。

facet_text_en: Insatiable Hunger also applies to nearby Spiderlings.
facet_text_zh: 极度饥渴还会施加给附近的小蜘蛛。

abilities.name: broodmother_spin_web
abilities.description_zh: 编织出一张蜘蛛网，育母蜘蛛在蛛网里被动提升移动速度和转身速率，并且获得无视地形移动的能力。织网现在可向其他蛛网触及的区域全地图施放。蛛网永久存在，不过可以手动摧毁。当其数量超过上限，最早的蛛网将会消失。
abilities.description_en: Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
facet_text_en: Reduces health restoration of enemies on webs that are in the same web network as Broodmother.
facet_text_zh: 减少育母蜘蛛所在蛛网上敌人的生命回复。

abilities.name: broodmother_incapacitating_bite
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛用毒液削弱敌方单位，使她的攻击带有减速效果，中毒单位的攻击有一定概率落空，并且被攻击时承受额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
notes_zh: 攻击落空几率与闪避和上下坡丢失叠加。
notes_en: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.

abilities.name: broodmother_sticky_snare
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多%count%个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。
abilities.description_en: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.

abilities.name: broodmother_spiders_milk
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和%kill_heal_aoe%范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续%kill_heal_duration%秒的状态效果，每%tick_rate%秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少%kill_creeps_penalty%%%。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a %kill_heal_aoe% radius receive a buff for %kill_heal_duration%s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every %tick_rate% seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by %kill_creeps_penalty%%%.

abilities.name: broodmother_spawn_spiderlings
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛将她的卵注入敌人体内，造成伤害和减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。如果目标在感染期间被击杀，卵会孵化成小蜘蛛。
abilities.description_en: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
notes_zh: 如果目标在受到此技能后%buff_duration%秒内被杀死，小蜘蛛就会孵化。
被小蜘蛛杀死的单位会生出额外的小蜘蛛。
notes_en: If the target is killed within %buff_duration% seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_broodmother_web_speed
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_movespeed}% Spin Web Move Speed and Ignore Speed Limit
